Inexact rows 173 = mismatched 144 + last-digit 29; real fixtures (≥ 1 row with |Δ| ≥ 0.05 px) **63 fixtures / 133 rows** (120 rows ≥ 0.05 px + 13 sub-pixel rows kept with their fixture); precision fixtures (ALL rows |Δ| < 0.05 px) **27 fixtures / 40 rows** (40 + 13 = the README's 53 sub-pixel rows); unmatched **4** fixtures. Labels are first-match on `in.puml` in the classifier order given in `batch-0/T0-baseline-and-partition.md`; The pseudo-state pattern is matched case-insensitively (PlantUML stereotype names are case-insensitive; `<<entrypoint>>` in bitaxo-18/resido-15) — the only flag needed to reproduce the preview. `composite` split alphabetically at the median into `composite-a`/`composite-b`; `creole-sprite`+`escape` merged.
